discussions.title: Sanctuary LED wall (9ft x 12ft, 1.9mm) driven by NovaStar VX1000
discussions.summary: New 9ft x 12ft, 1.9mm fine-pitch altar wall (~1920x1440 ~2.76M px, TO CONFIRM off NovaStar) driven by the on-hand VX1000 all-in-one (6.5M px cap, 10240x8192 max, 2x HDMI1.4 / 2x DVI / 3G-SDI / 2x 10G fiber, 3x 4K layers, 1-frame latency, genlock, 10 presets, RJ45/USB + NovaStar API). Chose the VX1000 we already have over a new processor — capacity and inputs cover this wall with headroom.

discussions.title: Signal path: PoeTech Presenter -> HDMI/DVI -> VX1000 -> wall (NDI is LAN routing, not wall-direct)
discussions.summary: Presenter -> HDMI/DVI -> VX1000 -> wall. VX1000 has NO native NDI input; NDI->HDMI bridge needed if NDI transport is ever wanted into the wall. NDI = production-LAN routing (cameras/feeds/other screens), not the direct wall feed. Direct video cable is simplest/lowest-latency/most-reliable.
